scope: Non-activating audit of the delayed TG2 runtime-v7 fixed-endpoint seed-1002 job and the shared TG1 fixed-scene retry exhaustion

scientific_equivalence_evidence: The v7 and v8 requests use the same staging commits, image, four-H20 resource, arm, seed, frozen runner, processor bridge, data, initialization, optimizer, global batch, and step count.
Runtime v8 changes only the runtime label and an ephemeral LAWAM_RUN_TIMESTAMP suffix that prevents concurrent log-directory collisions.
The delayed v7 initialization hashes match the five previously captured TG2 North initialization snapshots.

reasons: Runtime-v8 amendment invariant requires cells that were pending or queued when v8 was admitted to use v8; this v7 job was queued and detached at that time.
The scheduler records this job as a superseded attempt rather than the current managed attempt.
No final checkpoint, step-20000 optimizer/trainer state, or four-rank data-order sidecar set exists yet.
No explicit amendment authorizes adopting a delayed superseded v7 attempt.

decision_boundary: An explicit amendment may authorize the delayed v7 job only after successful platform termination, a complete step-20000 state, four valid data-order sidecars, exact source and initialization verification, and proof that no second matching run directory exists.
Otherwise the delayed v7 output must remain excluded, and a clean v8 run requires an explicitly authorized preservation/quarantine procedure that leaves all evidence intact.
Until one path is authorized, the delayed v7 job is health telemetry only and must not satisfy a TODO checkbox or downstream integrity dependency.

tg1_fixed_scene_retry.diagnosis: Stochastic simulator/setup validity under a retry cap that is too small for the frozen scene panel; not a permanently invalid scene identity or a method-specific inference failure.

minimal_amendment_boundary.precedent: Existing formal pi0.5 fixed-scene evaluation launchers in this repository use ROBOTWIN_FIXED_SEED_MAX_ATTEMPTS=500.
must_remain_unchanged: scene manifest and all 1,200 accepted scene identities
tasks, eval seeds, interventions, execution cadence, control rate, episode count, and analysis gates
fixed-scene verifier and requirement for exactly 24 complete cells per condition
minimal_amendment_boundary.required_rerun_scope: Archive incomplete roots and rerun every condition in the affected TG1A and TG1B panels under one common amended retry cap; do not mix partial old cells with amended cells.
forbidden_shortcuts: raise the cap for only one arm
